title: [DEV] I wanted a game like Pokémon, but about collecting insects
author: Phamasan
selftext:
Hey everyone

I am Martin, the solo dev behind Chitin which is an insect-collecting idle auto-battler I have been building for the past 6 months or so (and still do).

I started this with zero experience (I work in Marketing and Communcations) besides some other failed attempts. Basic coding experience, but no game dev background or anything, just me, AI, and a lot of late nights (after bedtime stories), and a helluva lot of fun during the process and seeing the results.

Chitin has been live for about a month now, and I'm super grateful for the small but dedicated playerbase that's grown around it. They report bugs and suggest features, and are just really helpful.

I'm actively pushing fixes, squashing bugs, adding content, and have some bigger update(s) on the way.

If any of this sounds like your kind of thing, bug/insect collecting/rpg-elements/idler, I would love for you to give it a try: \[Download Chitin here\](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.phampers.chitin)

If you try it out, thank you so, so much!

🦗
